newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cebu Property Q1 1997 net up 491 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cebu Property Q1 1997 net up 491 pct.

text.p: Cebu Property Ventures & Development Corp said on Monday it posted a 43.7 million peso net income for the first quarter of 1997, up 491 percent from 7.4 million pesos in the year-ago period.
In a statement, Cebu Property said its consolidated revenues from real estate operations and short-term investments amounted to 109.2 million pesos.
The company said the development of its flagship project, the 24-hectare Cebu Civic and Trade Center in the central Cebu province, has been started.
The firm said last year's 242 percent rise in profits to 116.3 million was largely due to earnings from sales of office lots at the center.
Cebu Property is a subsidiary of Ayala Corp.
